scope: Snapshot before roster-wide mouth recovery, with three priority repair results. Source SHA-256 values identify precisely which deliveries were sampled. Later main changes require rerunning throat-audit.mjs.
limits: Edge strain locates candidates, not intersections. Mouth-region membership includes neck/pouch influences and can include limb roots. Hidden legacy oral surfaces are inventoried separately. This is not a blanket visual approval of every animation.
